minutes.headline: Select Board re-voted the election ballot to add the omitted town moderator seat, as a write-in only.
minutes.summary: An emergency one-item meeting: the town moderator's seat had been left off the caucus and election ballot. The board agreed to sign a revised ballot listing the position with no candidate, so it is write-in only, and then adjourned.

decisions.decision: The town moderator seat will appear on the ballot with no name, as write-in only, because the caucus and nomination deadlines had passed.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-0 by roll call to approve and sign a revised election ballot that adds the town moderator position.
The moderator seat will appear with no candidate name, so it is write-in only, because the caucus and nomination deadlines had already passed.
Members are to go to town hall, Monday at the earliest, to sign five copies of the reprinted ballot warrant.
The seat had been left off the caucus and election ballot; the board then adjourned.

why_it_matters: Residents voting in the town election will find the moderator office on the ballot with no printed candidate, so any winner would be decided by write-in votes.
watch_next: The signing of the five copies of the reprinted ballot warrant at town hall, Monday at the earliest.
